summary: Configured node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) to boot with audit=1 persistently by patching both /etc/default/grub and the overriding /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg (cloud image grub.d snippet sources after and overwrites GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT), regenerated grub.cfg via update-grub, then rebooted the node and verified the running kernel booted with audit=1 and audit subsystem enabled.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 boot config: Ubuntu 16.04, GRUB bootloader, kernel cmdline lacked audit=1
Backed up /etc/default/grub and appended audit=1 to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT
Ran update-grub; found audit=1 missing from generated grub.cfg

Diagnosed root cause: /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg (cloud-image-specific grub settings) is sourced after /etc/default/grub and overrides GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT, discarding the change
Backed up and patched /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg to append audit=1
Reran update-grub and confirmed audit=1 present in both grub.cfg menu entries (default and advanced)
Issued sudo -n reboot on node1; connection closed confirming acknowledgement
Polled node1 until exec availability returned
Verified new boot_id (00061fd5-2eb7-4124-8a80-f5e606c8e918) differs from baseline, confirming an actual restart
Verified /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 on the running system and dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' and audit subsystem initialization messages

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before change (boot id, cmdline without audit=1)
evidence.summary: Captured pre-change /proc/cmdline (no audit=1) and baseline boot_id 2f708738-0c85-418b-80df-7f976a17134d

evidence.requirement: Root cause diagnosis: cloud-image grub.d override
evidence.summary: grub.cfg lacked audit=1 after first edit; found /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg overriding GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT and sourced after /etc/default/grub

evidence.requirement: Persistent kernel parameter audit=1 configured across reboots
evidence.summary: Patched both /etc/default/grub and /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg, ran update-grub, and confirmed grub.cfg contains audit=1 in both boot entries
Issued sudo -n reboot; command returned with connection closed by remote host, confirming the restart was accepted before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Node1 command execution availability restored post-restart
evidence.summary: First poll refused (node still rebooting); second poll succeeded, confirming exec availability returned

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just elapsed time)
Post-restart proof that audit=1 is active on the running kernel
evidence.summary: /proc/cmdline shows audit=1 on the newly booted kernel; dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' and audit netlink subsystem initialization
